name: com.district-hq/listings
title: District Listings
description: Search London managed offices by team size, area and budget. Read only, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Searches District's published, operator-committed London office listings for a team, by the number of desks, an area (for example Fitzrovia) and, optionally, the month the team wants to move in (startMonth, YYYY-MM) and a maximum budget. Only the area, the number of desks and a budget, where given, leave a listing out; the start month ranks results and does not remove one, so a returned listing can miss it. Returns count (listings that meet the area and team size, and the budget where given) and matchCount (those that match everything asked). Each listing has its operator's public name, desk range, published price and price for each commitment length the operator has set, a one line availability summary with its status, the days it was last confirmed, misses (what it misses of what was asked; a listing with any misses is not counted in matchCount and is not a match for everything asked) and url, its District listing page, where viewings are requested and enquiries are made. Read only: it cannot book a viewing, make an enquiry or show contact details.

desks.description: Number of desks the team needs

seats.description: The same as desks; use desks

area.description: One London area or neighbourhood, e.g. 'Fitzrovia'

areas.description: Several London areas, e.g. ['Shoreditch','Clerkenwell'] (max 5); treated as alternatives

startMonth.description: Month the team wants to move in, as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2027-01. Ranks listings; never removes one

budgetBasis.description: Basis the budget is quoted in; defaults to desk_month

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns one published District workspace by id (from search_listings): its name, type, operator's public name, area, postcode and postcode district, desk range, published price (on the basis the operator quotes it, stating whether VAT is included), its price for each commitment length the operator has set, its availability, the day the operator last confirmed it, and url, its District listing page, where viewings are requested and enquiries are made. Read only: it returns no contact details and cannot book or enquire.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Returns the published availability of one District workspace: whether it is available now, available from a date, needs confirming or unavailable, how many desks it holds, and its published price. Optional inputs: desks (the team size), to learn whether it holds them, and startMonth (YYYY-MM), to learn whether it is free in time. This is the operator's published availability, the same as the District listing page shows. needs_confirming means the operator has not confirmed the space is free for that time, so it is not a statement that the space is available. requestViewingUrl is the District listing page, where viewings are requested. Read only: it cannot book, enquire or show contact details.

desks.description: Team size, to check the listing holds them

startMonth.description: Month the team wants to move in, as YYYY-MM
